title: Finding the Tsar's submarine Som and questioning by the Swedish 'FBI'

tellings.quote: wreck we found was 2015. We found the Russian Tsar's submarine, Som. Wow.

plain: Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter who searches the Baltic Sea floor between Sweden and Finland, says that in 2015 he and his team, including Peter Lindberg, found the wreck of Som, a submarine built around 1904 for the Russian Tsar. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that after the find he was questioned in Stockholm by what he calls the Swedish "FBI", meaning the country's security police. He tells it as part of his wider story of the Baltic, where he also says he found a strange object on the seafloor.
